If an agent works all night under an employee’s login, whose actions appear in the morning?
AI access needs a clear owner, not a borrowed credential. In 'AI at Work, Under Control', we’ll explore separate identities for people and agents, access to approved tools, and data protections across models, tools, and web uploads.

Join Cloudflare for a practical look at keeping AI work attributable without stopping useful experimentation. https://cfl.re/4szbWuH
